name: the-cleaners-place
description: Run your cleaning business from ChatGPT: today's jobs, customers, quotes, invoices, pay runs and reports, with ready-made workflows for owners, managers and cleaners.

interface.shortDescription: Run your cleaning business by chatting
interface.longDescription: Connect your The Cleaners Place account to check today's jobs, find customers, send quotes and invoices, review pay runs and see reports. It only does what your role can already do, and asks you to confirm anything that spends money, emails a customer, or deletes data.
